name: ChatNova AI Chatbot
author: chatnova

sections.description:
ChatNova AI Chatbot is a powerful WordPress plugin that adds an intelligent, floating AI chatbot to your website. Perfect for customer support, lead generation, and visitor engagement, ChatNova leverages advanced AI technology to provide natural, helpful conversations with your visitors.

Key Features:

  • 🤖 AI-Powered Conversations – Natural language processing for intelligent responses
  • 💬 Persistent Chat History – Conversations are saved and restored across browser sessions
  • 🔒 Domain Isolation – Secure conversation isolation by domain for multi-site setups
  • 📝 Lead Capture – Collect visitor information (name, email, mobile) before starting conversations
  • 🎨 Customizable UI – Adjust chatbot name, colors, and appearance to match your brand
  • 📊 Conversation Tracking – All conversations are logged for analysis and improvement
  • 🌐 Multi-language Ready – Internationalization support built-in
  • 📱 Responsive Design – Works beautifully on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
  • ⚡ Fast & Lightweight – Optimized code for minimal impact on page load times
  • 🔐 Secure – Built with WordPress security best practices

How It Works:

  1. Install and activate the ChatNova plugin
  2. Get your API key from ChatNova Dashboard
  3. Configure the plugin settings (API key, chatbot name, custom prompts)
  4. The chatbot widget automatically appears on all pages of your site
  5. Visitors can click the chat icon to start conversations

Service Integration:

ChatNova connects to our secure API service at chatnova.app to process AI conversations. The plugin communicates with our servers to:
– Authenticate your API key
– Process chat messages using advanced AI models
– Store conversation history
– Capture lead information

By using this plugin, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Requirements:

  • An active ChatNova account (free trial available)
  • API key from your ChatNova dashboard
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • WordPress 5.0 or higher

Support:

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit:
* Support Forum
* Contact Us

Privacy Policy

ChatNova AI Chatbot connects to external services operated by ChatNova (chatnova.app) to provide AI-powered chat functionality.

Data Collected:
* Visitor name, email, and mobile number (with consent)
* Chat messages and conversation history
* Website domain and session information
* User preferences and settings

How Data Is Used:
* To provide AI-powered chat responses
* To improve service quality
* To enable conversation history features
* To support customer service

Data Sharing:
No data is shared with third parties except as required to provide the service (AI processing) or as required by law.

User Rights:
Users can request deletion of their data by contacting chatnova@zohomail.in

For full details, see our Privacy Policy.

Third-Party Services

This plugin relies on the following external services:

ChatNova API (chatnova.app)
* Purpose: API key verification, AI message processing, conversation storage
* Service URL: https://chatnova.app
* Terms: https://chatnova.app/terms
* Privacy: https://chatnova.app/privacy

By using this plugin, you agree to the terms and privacy policy of these services.

Credits

ChatNova AI Chatbot is developed and maintained by ChatNova Team.

Special thanks to the WordPress community for their continuous support and feedback.

Additional Information

  • Official Website
  • Support Forum
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation:

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “ChatNova AI Chatbot”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Go to ChatNova Chatbot in the admin menu
  6. Enter your API key and configure settings

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin
  6. Go to ChatNova Chatbot in the admin menu
  7. Enter your API key and configure settings

Getting Your API Key:

  1. Visit ChatNova
  2. Sign up for a free account
  3. Navigate to your dashboard
  4. Copy your API key
  5. Paste it in the plugin settings and click “Verify API Key”
sections.faq:
Do I need a ChatNova account?

Yes, you need a free ChatNova account to use this plugin. Sign up at chatnova.app to get your API key.

Is there a free trial?

Yes! ChatNova offers a free 3-month trial with full access to all features. No credit card required.

How do I customize the chatbot appearance?

Go to the ChatNova Chatbot settings page in your WordPress admin panel. You can customize the chatbot header name, system prompt, and other settings.

Does the chatbot work on mobile devices?

Yes! The chatbot is fully responsive and works seamlessly on all devices including smartphones and tablets.

Where is my conversation data stored?

Conversation data is stored securely on ChatNova servers and in your browser’s local storage for quick access. All data is encrypted and follows GDPR compliance standards.

Can I use this on multiple websites?

Yes, but each website requires its own API key. You can manage multiple websites from your ChatNova dashboard.

What happens if I exceed my message limit?

The chatbot will display a notification to visitors. You can upgrade your plan in the ChatNova dashboard to increase your message limit.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes, the plugin is designed with privacy in mind. Visitor consent is obtained before data collection, and all data handling follows GDPR guidelines.

Can I customize the AI responses?

Yes! Use the “Custom System Prompt” field in the plugin settings to define how your AI assistant should behave and respond.

What browsers are supported?

The chatbot works on all modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and Opera.
